newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July 1st 20-days trade surplus up 126.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan July 1st 20-days trade surplus up 126.4 pct.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus rose 126.4 percent to 480.57 billion yen in the first 20 days of July compared with a revised surplus of 212.26 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry announced on Wednesday.
The figure compared with a trade surplus of 453.20 billion yen in the first 20 days of June.

Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 10.5 percent to 2.64 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports fell 0.8 percent to 2.15 trillion yen, the ministry said in a statement.
